name: Burning Man
unique: A temporary city of 70,000 in the Black Rock Desert, built around radical self-reliance, giant art, fire and a gift economy, then erased without a trace.
buzz: People call it life-changing and brutal in the same sentence; dust storms, heat and logistics are serious. Read the survival guide twice.

name: Great Basin Dark Sky
unique: One of the darkest skies in the lower 48, above a glacier-carved mountain and ancient bristlecone pines, with a astronomy program and a cave tour.
buzz: The Milky Way casts shadows; rangers run excellent telescope programs. It is genuinely remote — fill your tank in Ely.

name: Black Canyon Kayak
unique: Paddle the Colorado below Hoover Dam between 900-foot black volcanic walls, with hot springs, emerald water and no road access.
buzz: The guided kayak and raft trips are the only way in; the scale is humbling and the water is cold. Book early in summer.

name: Omega Mart at Area15
unique: A fake supermarket that opens into a surreal corporate conspiracy across four floors, with a story you solve by opening products and following clues.
buzz: People spend four hours and still miss rooms; the bar inside is a nice pause. Book the first slot of the day.

name: Red Rock Canyon
unique: A 13-mile scenic loop through red and tan sandstone, with Calico Tanks, petroglyphs and world-class trad climbing twenty minutes from the Strip.
buzz: The best antidote to Vegas; go at sunrise and take the scenic drive. Timed entry is required in season.

name: Rhyolite Ghost Town
unique: A bank, a school and a bottle house abandoned in the desert, plus an open-air sculpture park of ghostly figures that makes the ruin feel haunted.
buzz: The sculpture park is the surprise; go at golden hour and watch for heat and rattlesnakes. Combine with Death Valley.
